PAY OR QUIT NOTICE

Dear John Doe, you owe $1,200 in rent for October. You have 3 days from Oct 10, 2026 to pay this amount or vacate the premises. If you fail to do so, an eviction lawsuit will be filed against you in housing court.

14-Day Notice to Terminate Tenancy

Tenant: Jane Smith. Address: 123 Maple St. You have violated your lease by keeping an unauthorized pet. You must remove the pet or vacate the property by Oct 24, 2026.

FINAL DISCONNECTION NOTICE

Your electricity bill of $150.50 is past due. If payment is not received by Oct 15, 2026, your service will be disconnected. To restore service after disconnection, a reconnect fee of $50 will apply.
URGENT TAX NOTICE: You owe back taxes of $4,500. Please call us immediately at 555-0199 or face immediate arrest by local police. Pay via iTunes gift cards today to clear your warrant.

SUMMONS AND COMPLAINT

You are being sued. You must file a written answer with the court within 20 days. Date of service: Oct 1, 2026. Failure to answer will result in a default judgment against you.
